card.text: One of the first clusters in which gravitational lensing was seen, as it was 4.2 billion years ago.

sources.label: ESA/Hubble heic1711a: NASA, ESA/Hubble, HST Frontier Fields
sources.locator: caption: Abell 370 is one of the very first galaxy clusters in which astronomers observed the phenomenon of gravitational lensing

introduction.text: Hubble's view: the pale galaxies are the cluster, and the long arcs are far galaxies stretched by its gravity. The picture is flat and has no depth.
